biotools.summary: BIBSNet is an open-source deep learning model designed for robust and generalizable brain tissue segmentation in MRI scans of infants (0-8 months). It processes MR data to segment various brain tissues, which is critical for studying early brain development.
biotools.name: BIBSNet: Baby Image Brain Segmentation Network
